evidence.author: brannu_film
evidence.content: Brandon “Brannu” Fulton isn't seeking revenge nor retribution. He's simply asking for an apology. After a young @southfultonpolice officer wrongly detained him right outside his property, Brannu used the moment to do something far more powerful: he schooled the officer on nuance, perspective, and what it truly means to wear a badge. Instead of matching disrespect with disrespect, he challenged the officer’s training, demeanor, and judgment, forcing him to confront the human consequences of approaching people without understanding the full context. A teaching moment. Sometimes the strongest form of accountability isn’t anger—it’s making someone stop, listen, and recognize where they went wrong. #Brannu #Documentary #ATLFilm #SouthFulton #Police
